about.title: About me
about.summary: Senior Software Engineer with {expYears}+ years in production software. I progressed from technical support to technical ownership across backend, cloud and security. I turn ambiguous requirements into architecture, implementation, deployment and production support, with direct customer communication in English and Spanish. University teaching in parallel (2–4 hrs/week). English C2. Based in Medellín and primarily remote.
about.role: Senior Software Engineer | Backend · Cloud · Security
about.motto: Take the ambiguous problem and own it through to production.
about.bio: At Heinsohn since April 2022. Senior Software Developer since March 2024. On CareTree and Dala (healthcare platforms on AWS) I take technical ownership on a reduced team: data migration, security, delivery and operational continuity. On IRC I work TypeScript end to end (NestJS, React and React Native) on GCP, prioritizing agility and reuse. When support cannot reproduce a case, I join the customer session — including in English — find the root cause and close it. I classify every request as urgent, important or an improvement based on operational impact.

experienceIntro: Over {expYears} years in production software. Senior Software Developer at Heinsohn since March 2024. University teaching in parallel.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
experience.intro: Technical ownership on CareTree/Dala healthcare platforms (AWS) and IRC digital products (GCP). Small teams; informal technical leadership, not people management.
bullets: Designed and implemented the CareTree → Dala information migration from an ambiguous request: plan, responsibilities, tooling and architecture using AWS Glue, S3, Snowflake as the source of truth, a Medallion architecture, schemas, pipes, triggers and consumption endpoints; optimized jobs to improve processing efficiency.

After a cybersecurity specialization, assessed CareTree, prioritized vulnerabilities from critical to lower severity and worked with the team on remediation. Implemented active file scanning with ClamAV on AWS in a healthcare environment with strong security and privacy requirements.

Investigated a security incident from anomalous traffic alerts: analyzed Apache logs, identified unintended public exposure of the application server IP, reproduced the behavior under controlled conditions, communicated the root cause and supported remediation in approximately 30 minutes.

On IRC, with a team of ~2 developers plus data and AI, organized incomplete requirements focused on agility and reuse. Drove an initial working release with TypeScript end to end: NestJS backend, React web and React Native mobile on GCP, with CI/CD and infrastructure; coordinated store listings and infrastructure with client IT.

When support cannot reproduce CareTree or Dala incidents, I join English-language customer sessions: clarify expected behavior, find the root cause, update the ticket, propose and implement the fix and communicate the outcome.
Established the delivery path: CI/CD from scratch, Terraform and infrastructure, feature branching and branch protections for controlled production changes.

Provide informal technical leadership and operational continuity (work coordination, technical decisions, blocker resolution) on CareTree/Dala, now sustained by a reduced team of ~2 developers. Collaborate on interface prototypes with stakeholders as part of product engineering.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.intro: Joined Heinsohn on CareTree. Grew from defined-scope execution to requirements discovery, solution design and technical continuity. After acquisition, CareTree became linked to Dala and I began working with their IT team.
bullets: Developed and integrated PHP/Laravel backend features for CareTree, a multi-company healthcare platform.
Moved from closed-scope tickets to stakeholder discovery, solution design and greater technical autonomy.
On Dala, took early bounded work on APIs, React interfaces and AWS architecture with their IT team.
Provided technical continuity when the lead was unavailable (original team ~7 people): work coordination and blocker resolution as informal leadership, not people management.

experience.title: University Professor
experience.intro: Teaching in parallel with software engineering: 2 to 4 hours a week, usually one course a month.
bullets: Courses in web services, operating systems, OOP, web programming, software design and analysis, databases, application security, web-oriented programming and emerging technologies.
Evidence of technical communication and mentoring; primary career remains Software Engineering.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.intro: QVO acquired the Business Solutions team. We delivered enterprise software for private-security companies: operations lived in Excel, and the system centralized operational, commercial, finance, CCTV, supplier and dashboard modules.
bullets: Full cycle in Laravel and MySQL: requirements, interface prototypes with the client, build, deployment, training and support.
Supported users resisting change so they could adopt the system and leave spreadsheets behind.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.intro: Custom object-oriented PHP software for specific companies: inventory, CRM and WordPress sites.
bullets: Management applications in PHP and Laravel aligned to each client's workflow, with interface prototypes before development.

experience.title: Software Developer

bullets: The CRM centralized documents, certificates, clients, venues and engagements.
Designed and prototyped interfaces with the client before building them.
